## About
SKIN@Mantraa is a physician-led dermatology and cosmetic dermatology clinic based in Swaroop Nagar, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, India. Dr. Mamta Bhura (MBBS, MD Dermatology, IMS BHU) provides evidence-based skin, hair, and aesthetic treatments tailored to Indian skin types.

## Services Offered
- Laser treatments (Nd:YAG, IPL, Diode laser for hair removal and skin rejuvenation)
- Acne and acne scar treatment
- Pigmentation and melasma treatment
- Chemical peels
- Microneedling and PRP therapy
- Anti-aging and skin rejuvenation
- Botox and dermal fillers
- Hair loss and hair restoration (PRP, mesotherapy)
- Skin disease diagnosis and medical dermatology
